name: Blackrock Depths
location: Blackrock Mountain: down the big chain to the central structure, through Forgewright's Tomb, down another chain, then left through the Grinding Quarry into the Masonry; portal in the far corner
strategy: High Interrogator Gerstahn: pull her into the cleared hallway; interrupt Mana Burn
Lord Roccor: high armour; healers watch for Ground Tremor
Houndmaster Grebmar: kill the wolves first; watch for Bloodlust

Ring of Law (random): Hedrum (cleanse poison), Gorosh (ranged out of Whirlwind), Anub'shiah (decurse), Ok'thor (dispel Polymorph), Grizzle (ranged far), Eviscerator (Shadow Protection), Theldren (kill adds first)
Pyromancer Loregrain: face away, kill the Scorching Totem
Warder Stilgiss: Stilgiss first (no frost), then Verek
Watchman Doomgrip: kill his three stone adds first
Fineous Darkvire: pull to a cleared area, interrupt Holy Light
Lord Incendius: tank mid-platform away from edges (knockback)
Bael'Gar: face the wall, kill the spawns
General Angerforge: pull him up the ramp; AoE the adds
Golem Lord Argelmach: kill the two constructs first
Grim Guzzler: Ribbly, Hurley Blackbreath and Plugger Spazzring: avoid AoE (patrons are neutral)
Phalanx: tank near the door; avoid Thunderclap
Ambassador Flamelash: kill adds before they reach him: a DPS race
Panzor the Invincible: don't cast into Spell Reflection
The Seven: pull each dwarf to the middle; interrupts and stuns
Magmus: tank in a corner; avoid the fire rows
Emperor Dagran Thaurissan: to save Princess Moira, interrupt her with a physical off-tank; otherwise kill her, then the Emperor
tips: Ring of Law bosses are random
Saving Moira gives no loot (quest only)

name: Lower Blackrock Spire
location: Blackrock Mountain: easiest via the big chain to Bodley's balcony, then drop down in front of the portal
strategy: Spirestone Butcher / Battle Lord / Lord Magus: crowd-control the pack, kill the named mob
Highlord Omokk: crowd-control adds; avoid Knock Away
Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin: decurse Curse of Blood
War Master Voone: tank at a wall; melee avoid Cleave
Mor Grayhoof: avoid Hurricane, interrupt Healing Touch, purge Rejuvenation
Mother Smolderweb: face away, hold threat
Crystal Fang: four adds spawn when it dies
Urok Doomhowl: use the Roughshod Pike on an ogre every 30 sec
Quartermaster Zigris: spread for Stun Bomb
Halycon: kill the Worg Pups first; eat and drink before Gizrul arrives
Gizrul the Slavener: defensives during Enrage
Ghok Bashguud: crowd-control his two elites
Overlord Wyrmthalak: tank at the wall; crowd-control adds at 50%

name: Upper Blackrock Spire
location: Through the LBRS portal, upstairs door on the left; someone needs the Seal of Ascension (quest from LBRS)
strategy: Pyroguard Emberseer: AoE the Incarcerator waves; ranged away from Fire Nova
Solakar Flamewreath: kill the whelp waves fast
Goraluk Anvilcrack: off-tank taunts during Backhand stuns
Warchief Rend Blackhand: main tank on Gyth, off-tank on Rend; kill Gyth first
The Beast: back to a wall; ranged at max range (fear, Flamebreak)
General Drakkisath: kill the guards; a Hunter or Mage kites Drakkisath
Jed Runewatcher (rare): tank at a wall
Lord Valthalak (summoned): kill adds at once; save cooldowns for the last 20%
tips: Use the Seal of Ascension during Rend to summon Vaelastrasz's heals

name: Scholomance
location: Caer Darrow, south-east Western Plaguelands; needs the Skeleton Key (quest chain); Rattlegore drops the Viewing Room Key
strategy: Kirtonos the Herald: back to a wall; regain threat after each form change
Jandice Barov: mark the real Jandice among her illusions
Rattlegore: pull him and one add to the foot of the stairs; add first
Marduk Blackpool: face away; melee stop during Shadow Shield
Vectus: spread for Flamestrike
Ras Frostwhisper: interrupt; ranged at max range
Kormok: pick up the skeletons; melee stop during Bone Shield
Lady Illucia Barov: crowd-control mind-controlled players
Lord Alexei Barov: decurse Veil of Shadow; kill him first
The Ravenian: clear the room so Knock Away doesn't fling you into adds
Lorekeeper Polkelt: avoid exploding zombies
Doctor Theolen Krastinov: burn before his 50% enrage
Instructor Malicia: interrupt everything
Darkmaster Gandling: tank in the middle; if teleported, kill the adds and rejoin
tips: Click the torch on Jandice's wall for secret loot later

name: Stratholme
location: North-west Eastern Plaguelands. Living side through the main gate; Undead side via the Eastwall Gate (Key to the City, from Magistrate Barthilas)
strategy: Living · Skul (rare): interrupt
Living · The Unforgiven: adds first
Living · Hearthsinger Forresten: spread for Multi-Shot; regain threat after Lullaby
Living · Postmaster Malown: needs postbox keys from the Stratholme Courier
Living · Timmy the Cruel: heal through his Enrage
Living · Cannon Master Willey: use the cannons to deal with his adds
Living · Archivist Galford: spread for Burning Winds
Living · Balnazzar: dispel Deep Sleep; ranged out of Psychic Scream (needs The Scarlet Key for the Bastion)
Undead · Nerub'enkan: tank at the top of the ramp; AoE the scarabs
Undead · Baroness Anastari: damage a possessed player to 50% to free them; decurse
Undead · Maleki the Pallid: interrupt Drain Life and Frostbolt
Undead · Magistrate Barthilas: tank at a wall (knockback)
Undead · Ramstein the Gorger: have a taunt ready for Knockout
Undead · Baron Rivendare: tank in the back-right corner; ranged far left; melee behind
tips: Clicking the ground patterns summons Crimson Hammersmith or Black Guard Swordsmith
Opening the Gauntlet starts the 45-minute Baron's Ultimatum timer (Tier 0.5 quest)
